messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: sustained KV cache memory growth leading to OOMs on hosted runtime (clusters: us-west-2, eu-central-1). Symptoms: streaming stalls, 5xx surge, and degraded tail latency. Alert group: kvcache-prefetch-high-growth.

sara_oncall: Oncall ack. Spinning up triage. Any immediate customer calls?

maria_support: Yep — two enterprise customers in eu-central reported streaming timeouts and partial transcripts. Escalated to account teams. I'm creating incident tickets.

tom_sre: Pulling runtime metrics. Seeing unusually high per-session kv_entries and a sharp increase in continuous_batching prefetch ops starting at 08:07 UTC. Queue lengths spiked before memory errors.

lee_runtime: Can someone paste the runtime config and recent rollouts? We had a rollout of adaptive_prefetch_v2 to hosted yesterday night. That changed how prefetch windows are computed for streaming.
sara_oncall: Logs snippet from one host:

```
2026-03-20T08:07:12Z ERROR kvcache: allocate failed: requested_nodes=18000, free_nodes=1200, session=longsess-9876
2026-03-20T08:07:13Z WARN continuous_batching: prefetch_calc returned window=16384 for session longsess-9876
2026-03-20T08:07:14Z INFO runtime: route=streaming/model-x, batch_len=256, inflight_prefetch=48
```

olivia_eng: 16384 tokens prefetched for a single session — that's a runaway. Does this correlate with any customer-side SDK changes? Could be malicious or misbehaving client.

maria_support: Customer logs show a client-side bug that repeatedly reconnected streaming sessions with incremental offsets; the runtime treated each reconnect as needing complete context re-prefetch.

lee_runtime: That explains the repeated prefetch for same session id variants. Immediate mitigations: 1) disable adaptive_prefetch_v2 via feature flag; 2) enable reconnect dedupe so reconnects reuse existing KV; 3) force batch_size cap to 96 to reduce mem pressure. What's fastest?
sara_oncall: Feature flag flip is fastest. I'll request rollback. Also we can temporarily block very large prefetch windows at the allocator level.

deploy-bot: Received request: `ffctl toggle adaptive_prefetch_v2 --off --env hosted --clusters us-west-2,eu-central-1`

deploy-bot: Toggling feature flag... done. Propagation ~30s.

devops-bot: Applying runtime knob: `runtimectl set kvcache.alloc_hard_cap_tokens 4096 --scope hosted` (one-line change, no restart).

sara_oncall: Also setting `runtimectl set kvcache.batch_max 96 --scope hosted`

tom_sre: After flag off + knobs applied: memory allocations dropped within one minute. OOM count down from 32/min to 0/min. Error rate in streaming routes reduced by ~85%.

lee_runtime: Good. Need a small code patch to add reconnect dedupe for streaming sessions to avoid future re-prefetch storms. I'll open PR. In the meantime, can we blacklist client user-agents that show the reconnect pattern?
maria_support: We can throttle at proxy for offending API keys — I've put two API keys into temporary rate-limits to prevent repeated reconnections.

olivia_eng: Patch PR: https://git.internal/rw/runtime/pull/4580 — adds reconnect dedupe and a defensive max_prefetch limiter in streaming path (defaults to 8k). Adding tests.

lee_runtime: Request expedited review. Also propose we add a new alert: sudden per-session kv_entry growth > 5000 in 1m should page SRE.
sara_oncall: Agree. I'm adding that alert now.

deploy-bot: PR merged after expedited review. Rolling hotfix to hosted with 2% canary in us-west-2.

devops-bot: Canary deploy started: rollout_id=cb-20260320-01. Monitoring memory and error metrics.

maria_support: Customer impact update: 2 enterprise customers experienced ~3-5 minute windows of 5xxs; many smaller tenants saw transient stalls. Logged impact to INC-3660007654, raising severity to Sev2 until canary completes.

tom_sre: Canary looks good for 10 minutes. Memory curve stabilized. No new OOMs. Increasing rollout to 20%.

olivia_eng: Adding synthetic long-session test to CI: `make e2e-long-stream` which simulates reconnects with offsets and verifies dedupe prevents redundant prefetch. Test added to nightly as well.

lee_runtime: Postmortem notes for later: root cause = adaptive_prefetch_v2 over-aggressive window growth combined with reconnect semantics in streaming; contributing factor = lack of reconnect dedupe and missing hard cap in streaming path. Immediate mitigation = feature flag rollback + runtime hard caps + proxy throttles. Long-term = reconnect dedupe + alerting + CI tests.
sara_oncall: Handoff: I'm going to hand to Tom for follow-up and postmortem. My shift ends in 18m. If anything breaks ping @tom_sre.

tom_sre: Taking owner for post-incident. I'll assemble timeline, customer impact, and action items. Scheduling postmortem meeting for 2026-03-21 10:00 UTC.

maria_support: Support will send customer follow-ups post-canary green. Drafting communication now.

incident-bot: Incident INC-3660007654 updated: status=mitigated -> monitoring. Owner=tom_sre. Channel will stay open for 90 minutes.

olivia_eng: One last note: adding a small runtime metric exposing per-session prefetch_count so we can detect repeated prefetches per session id. I'll send a follow-up PR.

tom_sre: Thanks team. Handoff complete. :white_check_mark:

maria_support: Closing customer tickets once final verification done.

incident-bot: Timeline and actions recorded for INC-3660007654.
